pi.resource.label.base.name: Universal Resources
pi.task.dailyUniqueArrival.name: Claim Daily Unique Arrival Contracts
pi.task.dailyUniqueArrival.description: Claim all daily unique arrival contracts for unlocked airports. Make sure you have enough contract slots to avoid claim failures.
pi.task.unattendedMode.name: Unattended Mode
pi.task.unattendedMode.description: A rough auto-pilot mode for unattended operation. Currently only supports handling all action request events (all flight cards shown after filter).
pi.task.option.dockExtra.name: Dock Feature
pi.task.option.dockExtra.description: Master switch for Dock extension features.
pi.task.option.enableTower.name: Tower
pi.task.option.enableTower.description: Automatically start the Tower when the number of flight events is not 0, and extend it each time it is about to end.
pi.task.option.randomSelectStand.name: Random Stand
pi.task.option.randomSelectStand.descrip: Randomly select a stand for arriving flights. Even stands that are not unlocked will be included as random targets. If disabled, only the first stand will be selected.
pi.task.option.unknownPageWaitting.name: Page Waiting
pi.task.option.unknownPageWaitting.descr:
Wait when not on the home page, airport selection, or flight handling interface. If the option is disabled, it will immediately try to exit; if exiting fails, it will restart the game.
Note: This feature is not recommended. If manual intervention is needed, it is more advisable to stop the task first.
pi.task.option.ONNX.name: Neural Network Detection
pi.task.option.ONNX.description: Deep learning recognition model running locally
pi.task.option.ONNX.default.name: Auto Fallback
pi.task.option.ONNX.default.description: Automatically fallback to neural network detection when the default recognition method fails. This is the recommended option, balancing speed and accuracy.
pi.task.option.ONNX.reduceONNX.name: Prefer Speed
pi.task.option.ONNX.reduceONNX.descripti: Reduce the usage frequency of deep learning models.
pi.task.option.ONNX.preferONNX.name: Prefer Accuracy
pi.task.option.ONNX.preferONNX.descripti: Use neural network detection in more scenarios. This option consumes more computational resources and may generate significant heat on mobile devices; prolonged use is not recommended.
pi.task.option.bribery.name: Timeout Bribe
pi.task.option.bribery.description: In action request events, arriving flights may experience processing timeouts during ground handling allocation. Normal timeout occurrences generally do not affect contract continuation or upgrades. Enabling this option will impact the overall recognition speed of action request events.
pi.task.option.acceptDailyUniqueContract: How to handle daily unique arrival contracts after claiming them
When the number of special arrival contracts exceeds this value, automatic processing will start.
When the number of special arrival contracts drops to this value, processing will stop.
pi.task.option.entryAirportIATA.name: Airport IATA
pi.task.option.entryAirportIATA.descript: The IATA code of the airport to automatically enter after launching the game. Note: If already inside an airport when the task starts, it will not switch to the target airport.
pi.task.option.freezeCheck.name: Freeze Detection (currently unavailable)
pi.task.option.freezeCheck.description: Automatically restart the game when a frozen screen is detected. Please configure 'Airport IATA' before enabling this.
pi.preset.onlyDaily.name: Daily Only
pi.preset.onlyDaily.description: Only claim daily special arrival flight contracts and process special contracts.
pi.preset.noDaily.name: Idle Only
pi.preset.noDaily.description: Enter the airport directly to handle flights.
pi.preset.all.name: Full Idle
pi.preset.all.description: Claim daily special arrival flight contracts, process special contracts, then enter the designated airport for idle handling.
